title: Real time Air Quality Index
summary: Get Real time National Air Quality Index values from different monitoring stations across India. The pollutants monitored are Sulphur Dioxide (SO2), Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Particulate Matter (PM10 and PM2.5) , Carbon Monoxide (CO), Ozone(O3) etc.

title: National Social Assistance Programme(NSAP) Beneficiaries Abstract
summary: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a welfare programme being administered by the Ministry of Rural Development. This programme is being implemented in rural areas as well as urban areas.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)
summary: The Catalog contains dataset under Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM).

title: Region wise, District Wise, Commodity wise, Daily food stock Position of FCI
summary: Get data on Region wise, District Wise, Commodity wise, Daily food stock Position of FCI. Commodities are Bajra, Barley, DAAL Chana, Jowar, Maize, Masur, Moong, Paddy, Ragi, Rice-Parboiled, Rice-Raw, Sugar, Tur(Arhar), Urad, Wheat and Wheat URS (FIG.IN QTLS.)

title: Local Government Directory (LGD)
summary: LGD is a complete directory of Land Regions/Revenue, Rural and Urban Local Governments. LGD aims to keep all information about the structure of Local Governments and revenue entities online.

title: Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas (SVAMITVA)
summary: The scheme is a reformative step towards the establishment of clear ownership of property in rural inhabited (Abadi) areas, by mapping of land parcels using drone technology and providing Record of Rights to village household owners with the issuance of legal ownership cards (Property cards/Title deeds) to the property owners.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
summary: An Act to provide for the enhancement of livelihood security of the households in rural areas of the country by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

title: Surat Citizen Centric Services
summary: The catalog contains information related to statistical information related to various citizen centric services provided by Surat Municipal Corporation. The APIs are made available for Birth - Death Registration, Property Tax, Professional Tax, BRTS, City Bus, Building Plan approval, etc. The availability of data varies depending of the type of data set.
